items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I used to rehearse with a white fella, Paul Lane.

ctx.x: appetizer on, started on trucks you know. And what about Mardi Gras? Did you play many of those

the carnival? Oh yeah, I worked those white parades. I worked the carnival club, I worked the Eleonora, the Eleonora club, worked for the Lions, and jumped you know from one year to the other because they all paid big prices you know. I worked for the Lions for about four years straight. When I was working over in the pad at Funk and Manders. Then they formed a marching club. Well that made me, by me working there on Sundays, me and Howard and them working on Sundays, we worked at Matt and Lee. That made me just…
I used to rehearse with a white fella, Paul Lane. Paul Lane? Yeah.
